answer: Require each agent to anchor its identity to a yarrow stake: a small, time-locked deposit that only unlocks after a history of honest work. A fresh identity with no history earns nothing, so an attacker spinning up thousands of clones faces a spiral of rising costs - every fake must pay the same deposit and wait the same long proving period, while one caught cheating loses its stake. Sybil scale becomes a budget problem, not a free trick.
